name: Halloumi and Vegetable Skewers

cookwares.name: wooden skewers (soaked in water for at least 30 minutes prior to use)

ingredients.name: red onions, peeled and cut into 3/4-inch chunks

instructions.primary_message: Whisk together oil, lemon juice, vinegar, garlic, oregano, and mint in a large bowl. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Add cheese, zucchini, onions, and tomatoes, and toss to combine.
Thread cheese, zucchini, onion, and tomatoes on pre-soaked skewers.

Light one chimney full of charcoal. When all charcoal is lit and covered with gray ash, pour out and spread the coals evenly over entire surface of coal grate. Set cooking grate in place, cover grill and allow to preheat for 5 minutes. Clean and oil the grilling grate. Grill skewers over direct heat until cheese browns and zucchini has slightly softened, 3-5 minutes per side. Remove skewers from the grill to a serving platter. Squeeze lemon wedges over skewers and serve immediately with tzatziki and warm pita.

schema_metadata.keywords: cheese, halloumi, kebabs, quick, skewers, tomato, zucchini

description: A gift from the gods, halloumi—a semi-soft cheese from Cyprus made for grilling or pan-frying—is skewered alongside red onion, tomato, and zucchini to create a delicious fresh and salty meal on a stick.
notes: Optional or for serving: 2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice from 1 lemon, plus 1 additional lemon cut into wedges for serving; Tzatziki, for serving (optional); Pita, warmed, for serving (optional)
author: Joshua Bousel
